ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: The Impact of Light on Health

fullPassage:
The Impact of Light on Health

Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders.

However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most sensitivity to blue light.

In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can improve mental health by increasing the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night. This improves people's cognitive abilities and overall mental health.

questions.passage: Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it (A)[boosts / reduces] vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to (B)[promote / prevent] happiness and pleasure and (C)[reduce / increase] depression and anxiety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 햇빛은 비타민 D 수치를 높이고, 행복을 촉진하며, 우울증을 줄인다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① boosts — promote — reduce
❌ ② reduces — promote — increase
❌ ③ boosts — prevent — increase
❌ ④ reduces — prevent — reduce
✅ (A) boosts: 비타민 D를 높이는 긍정 효과. (B) promote: 행복과 즐거움을 촉진. (C) reduce: 우울증과 불안을 줄임.
det.tip: boosts(높이다) ↔ reduces(줄이다). promote(촉진) ↔ prevent(예방). reduce(줄이다) ↔ increase(늘리다).

questions.passage: Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light (A)[energize / relax] us, but they can also (B)[disturb / improve] sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that (C)[regulates / disrupts] night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 파란빛은 우리에게 활력을 주지만 수면 패턴을 방해할 수 있다. 멜라토닌은 주기를 조절하는 화학물질.
det.analysis:
✅ ① energize — disturb — regulates
❌ ② relax — disturb — disrupts
❌ ③ energize — improve — disrupts
❌ ④ relax — improve — regulates
✅ (A) energize: 파란빛의 각성 효과. (B) disturb: 수면 방해. (C) regulates: 멜라토닌의 주기 조절 기능.
det.tip: energize(활력을 주다) ↔ relax(이완하다). disturb(방해하다) ↔ improve(개선하다). regulate(조절하다) ↔ disrupt(교란하다).

questions.passage: In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can (A)[improve / worsen] mental health by (B)[increasing / decreasing] the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night. This improves people's (C)[cognitive / physical] abilities and overall mental health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 빨간빛은 정신건강을 개선하며, 멜라토닌 분비를 증가시켜 인지 능력을 향상시킨다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① improve — increasing — cognitive
❌ ② worsen — increasing — physical
❌ ③ improve — decreasing — physical
❌ ④ worsen — decreasing — cognitive
✅ (A) improve: 정신건강 개선. (B) increasing: 멜라토닌 증가로 수면 향상. (C) cognitive: 인지 능력.
det.tip: improve(개선) ↔ worsen(악화). cognitive(인지적) ↔ physical(신체적). 원문이 mental health 맥락이므로 cognitive.

questions.passage: Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones ①<u>stronger</u>, prevents diseases, and ②<u>heals</u> skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce ③<u>depression</u> and anxiety. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related ④<u>cures</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 햇빛 감소는 공황 발작과 불안 관련 장애(disorders)에 연결된다. cures(치료)는 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①stronger: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②heals: 원문 그대로. ✅ ③depression: 원문 그대로. ❌ ④cures: 원문은 disorders. 햇빛 감소의 부정적 결과에 cures(치료)는 모순.
det.tip: disorders(장애) ↔ cures(치료). 햇빛 부족 → 부정적 결과이므로 disorders.

questions.passage: Colors created by ①<u>artificial</u> light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also ②<u>disturb</u> sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most ③<u>sensitivity</u> to blue light. In contrast, red and yellow light are the ④<u>most</u> likely to impact our bodies.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빨간빛과 노란빛은 신체에 영향을 미칠 가능성이 가장 낮다(least). most는 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①artificial: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②disturb: 원문 그대로. ✅ ③sensitivity: 원문 그대로. ❌ ④most: 원문은 least. 'In contrast'로 대비되므로 least가 맞음.
det.tip: least(가장 적은) ↔ most(가장 많은). 대조 표현 In contrast에 주목.

questions.passage: Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, ①<u>prevents</u> diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the ②<u>release</u> of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote ③<u>happiness</u> and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety. On the other hand, ④<u>increases</u> in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 햇빛의 감소(reductions)가 공황 발작과 연결된다. increases(증가)는 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①prevents: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②release: 원문 그대로. ✅ ③happiness: 원문 그대로. ❌ ④increases: 원문은 reductions. On the other hand로 역접이므로 햇빛 감소가 부정적 결과.
det.tip: reductions(감소) ↔ increases(증가). 역접 On the other hand 뒤의 부정적 결과에 주의.

questions.passage: Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects __________. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 햇빛은 정신건강에도 영향을 미친다. 세로토닌이 행복을 촉진하고 우울증을 줄인다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②mental health: 세로토닌, 행복, 우울증 감소 모두 정신건강 관련. ❌ ①sleep quality: 수면은 2문단 주제. ❌ ③body weight: 무관. ❌ ④blood pressure: 무관.
det.tip: serotonin(세로토닌), happiness(행복), depression(우울증) → 모두 mental health(정신건강) 범주.

questions.passage: However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most __________ to blue light. In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 뇌는 파란빛에 가장 민감하다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③sensitivity: 파란빛에 대한 뇌의 민감도. ❌ ①resistance(저항): 반대 의미. ❌ ②attraction(매력): 무관. ❌ ④exposure(노출): 맥락 부적합.
det.tip: sensitivity to: ~에 대한 민감성. 'the most sensitivity to blue light' = 파란빛에 가장 민감.

questions.passage: Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin. The brain has the most sensitivity to blue light. In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can improve mental health by increasing the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night. This improves people's __________ abilities and overall mental health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수면 향상이 사람들의 인지 능력과 전반적 정신건강을 개선한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④cognitive: 원문 그대로. 수면 → 인지능력 향상은 논리적. ❌ ①athletic(운동): 무관. ❌ ②social(사회적): 무관. ❌ ③artistic(예술적): 무관.
det.tip: cognitive abilities: 인지 능력. 수면과 정신건강 맥락에서 인지능력 향상이 자연스러움.

questions.passage: Sunlight offers <u>numerous</u> health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'numerous'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 햇빛은 수많은 건강상의 이점을 제공한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②many: numerous ≈ many(많은). ❌ ①limited(제한된): 반대. ❌ ③specific(구체적): 다른 의미. ❌ ④temporary(일시적): 무관.
det.tip: numerous: 수많은. ≈ many, a lot of, a great number of.

questions.passage: Blue and white light energize us, but they can also <u>disturb</u> sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'disturb'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 파란빛은 수면 패턴을 방해할 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①disrupt: disturb ≈ disrupt(방해하다). ❌ ②enhance(강화하다): 반대. ❌ ③maintain(유지하다): 반대. ❌ ④establish(확립하다): 무관.
det.tip: disturb: 방해하다. ≈ disrupt, interfere with.

questions.passage: However, the impact of light <u>extends</u> beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'extends'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 빛의 영향은 햇빛 너머로 확장된다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③reaches: extends beyond ≈ reaches beyond(~너머까지 미치다). ❌ ①shrinks(줄어들다): 반대. ❌ ②limits(제한하다): 반대. ❌ ④disappears(사라지다): 반대.
det.tip: extend: 확장하다, 미치다. ≈ reach, stretch, spread.

questions.passage: Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and <u>reduce</u> depression and anxiety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'reduce'와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 우울증과 불안을 줄이다 ↔ 강화하다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④intensify: reduce(줄이다)의 반의어. 강화하다. ❌ ①decrease(줄이다): 동의어. ❌ ②lower(낮추다): 동의어. ❌ ③diminish(감소시키다): 동의어.
det.tip: reduce(줄이다) ↔ intensify(강화하다, 심화시키다). 나머지 3개는 모두 reduce와 유사.

questions.passage: Colors created by <u>artificial</u> light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'artificial'과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 인공적인 빛 ↔ 자연적인 빛.
det.analysis: ✅ ②natural: artificial(인공의)의 반의어. ❌ ①synthetic(합성의): 동의어. ❌ ③manufactured(제조된): 동의어. ❌ ④fake(가짜의): 유사.
det.tip: artificial(인공적인) ↔ natural(자연적인). 본문에서도 artificial light vs natural light 대비.

questions.passage:
(A) Natural light causes the <u>release</u> of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness.

(B) Exposure to red light in the evening can improve mental health by increasing the <u>release</u> of melatonin, which leads to better sleep.
questions.stem: (A)와 (B)의 'release'가 각각 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 세로토닌의 분비. (B) 멜라토닌의 분비. 둘 다 화학물질의 분비.
det.analysis: ✅ ③ 둘 다 분비: 뇌에서 화학물질이 나오는 것. release의 과학적 의미. ❌ ①②④: 석방/발매/해제는 다른 맥락.
det.tip: release: ①석방 ②발매 ③분비/방출 ④해제. 여기서는 화학물질의 분비.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the state of being in contact with something, especially something harmful or unpleasant"

det.korean: "특히 해롭거나 불쾌한 것과 접촉하는 상태" = 노출.
det.analysis: ✅ ②exposure: 노출. 정의와 일치. ❌ ①sensitivity(민감도): 다른 의미. ❌ ③depression(우울증): 무관. ❌ ④release(분비): 무관.
det.tip: exposure: 노출. 본문 'Exposure to red light'에서 등장. expose(동사) → exposure(명사).

questions.passage: Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

Regular exercise and a healthy diet are __________ (benefit) for both physical and mental health.

det.korean: 규칙적 운동과 건강한 식단은 신체·정신건강에 유익하다.
det.analysis: ✅ beneficial: are 뒤 보어 → 형용사. benefit(명사) → beneficial(형용사).
det.tip: benefit(명사: 이점) → beneficial(형용사: 유익한). be beneficial for = ~에 유익하다.

questions.passage: Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

The government introduced new __________ (regulate) to control air pollution in major cities.

det.korean: 정부는 대도시의 대기오염을 통제하기 위해 새로운 규정을 도입했다.
det.analysis: ✅ regulations: new + __________ → 명사. regulate(동사) → regulation(명사). 복수형 자연스러움.
det.tip: regulate(동사: 조절하다) → regulation(명사: 규정, 조절). new regulations = 새로운 규정들.

questions.passage: Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety. On the other hand, __________ in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 햇빛의 감소는 공황 발작과 관련이 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①reductions: On the other hand 역접 → 긍정에서 부정으로. 햇빛 감소 → 부정적 결과. ❌ ②improvements(개선): 역접 맥락 불일치. ❌ ③variations(변화): 약함. ❌ ④investments(투자): 무관.
det.tip: On the other hand: 반면에. 앞의 긍정적 효과와 대비되는 부정적 결과를 이끎.

questions.passage: However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most sensitivity to __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 뇌는 파란빛에 가장 민감하다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③blue light: 원문 그대로. 파란빛과 하얀빛이 수면 방해 → 뇌가 파란빛에 가장 민감. ❌ ①red light: 3문단 주제. ❌ ②yellow light: 영향이 적음. ❌ ④artificial light: 너무 광범위.
det.tip: 2문단의 핵심: Blue and white light → disturb sleep → brain most sensitive to blue light.
